meta.title: Why SkelApp – About Us
meta.description: SkelApp is on a mission to transform Tanzanian small businesses — built by people who show up, with products and support that just work.

hero.title: Transforming Tanzania's small businesses to grow — and communities to thrive.
hero.subtitle: We put powerful, affordable tools in the hands of every shop — so businesses grow stronger and the people around them thrive.

people.title:
People who
show up
people.copy: We take the time to understand what really matters to you. From the first discussion, we've got your back — and we see it through until it's right.

cards.title: The problem
cards.body: It's too hard for small shops to track sales, stock and cash — and grow without the numbers they need.

cards.title: The idea
cards.body: Put a simple, reliable point of sale in every shop — one that works offline and fits how Tanzania sells.

cards.title: The outcome
cards.body: Thousands of businesses now run on SkelApp — selling faster, wasting less and growing with confidence.

product.title:
Products that fuel
efficiency
product.subtitle: We build products that make your job easier and more profitable. From taking orders and payments to managing stock and staff — everything works together so you can focus on your customers.

support.title: Support
support.subtitle: When something matters, you reach a real person who knows your business — fast, local and on your side.

features.name: Always-on help
features.body: Reach us on WhatsApp, phone or email — real people who know retail, ready the moment you need them.

features.name: Set up in minutes
features.body: Hands-on onboarding and training so your whole team is selling confidently from the very first day.

features.name: On the ground
features.body: A local team in Dar es Salaam for setup, repairs and advice — not a call centre on the other side of the world.

features.name: Warranty & care
features.body: Every device is covered, and we keep you running with fast repairs and replacements when you need them.

culture.title: A culture that
culture.note: We're builders, problem-solvers and people who care. We move fast, stay close to our customers, and take pride in work that lasts — kazi safi, kila siku.
